title: Implement a bounded-concurrency promise task queue
prompt: Implement assertConcurrency in src/limits.js and createQueue in src/queue.js, then re-export both functions from src/index.js. Use ES modules and only Node built-ins; do not use timers. assertConcurrency(value) returns value when it is a positive safe integer and otherwise throws a RangeError. createQueue(concurrency = 1) validates concurrency and returns an object with push(task), size and active getters, and idle(). push returns a promise and accepts a function; a non-function task must produce a rejected promise with a TypeError without starting work or consuming a slot. Accepted tasks are started in FIFO order with at most concurrency tasks active at once. A task may return a value or a promise; its result or rejection reason must be forwarded to the promise returned by push, and a rejection must not stop later tasks. size is the number of tasks waiting to start and active is the number currently running; after push returns, both getters must already reflect the task's waiting or active state. idle() returns a promise that resolves once there are no waiting or active tasks, and resolves immediately when the queue is already empty. Tasks that enqueue more work are allowed, and idle() must wait until that work has also settled. Do not mutate task functions.
